# dsh-desktop-pet-codex
中文文档

A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a small always-on-top character plus a roster panel that shows
w

hat the conversations you care about are doing. It is two halves under one contract — a DSH Host
plu
gin that reads the Harness, and a Tauri window that draws it.

Idle
Working
Waiting
Finished
Wave
Heart
Nap

Seven animations: four looping states the pet switches between, and three short reactions it plays
o
nce. They are described below, together with the roster panel.
## Character states
A pet has one face, so the roster collapses to one mood. Attention beats activity beats aftermath: a
waiting conversation outranks a working one, a working one outranks a finished one, and `stopped` h

as
no face of its own — it borrows the quiet pose. While nobody waits, the pet wears the outcome of

the
most urgent conversation, so a finished turn stays on screen until something else happens.
| State | Animation | Shows when |

| **Idle**
| stands with her hands clasped; breathes, blinks on an uneven beat, shifts her weight |

nothing to report — the roster is empty, or its most urgent conversation has stopped |
| **Working**
| runs in profile, arms and legs cycling | a watched conversation is working; a subagent working ar

rives as its parent working |
| **Waiting**
| lifts a hand as if flagging someone down, holds it, th
en lowers it | a watched conversation is blocked on the reader — an approval, a question, a blocking

tool call |
| **Finished**
| hops with both arms up, lands and settles | a watched conversation fin

ished its turn |
| **Wave**
| raises one hand and waves it twice | the character is clicked |
| **He

art**
| presses her hands together at her chest and closes her eyes | the pointer lands on the chara

cter, at most once every 6 seconds |
| **Nap**
| drifts off standing up — eyes close, head drops — t
hen catches herself | the roster has been empty for five minutes; once per quiet spell |
The last three are one-shot segments: they play over whichever scene is showing, hand the sprite bac

k
when they end, and only a real scene change cuts one short. The scene tables live in
`pet-app/src/

pet-frames.ts`; the seven files shown above are named for their code names — `idle`,
`run`, `wait`,
`happy`, `wave`, `heart`, `doze`.

The GIFs under `docs/states/` are rendered from the same frame tables the window plays, by
`node too
ls/gen-readme-gifs.mjs` — no artwork is committed twice.
## Session list

The roster window is where the pet lists what it watches: the conversations the reader tracks, not
e
very session DSH knows, grouped by Workspace and anchored above the character.
Sample data: three Workspaces, two conversations waiting on the reader, and two indented subagent ro
ple data: three Workspaces, two conversations waiting on the reader, and two indented subagent rows.
**The header line counts what needs the reader.** While at least one watched conversation waits, it

reads `2 个会话在等你` in the waiting colour. Otherwise it splits into the outcomes, one coloured
segment

per phase that has any — `1 完成 · 2 进行 · 1 停止` — and an empty roster reads `全部空闲`. The
line under it

is the total: `共 6 个会话 · 2 在等你 · 2 进行中 · 1 已完成 · 1 已停止 · 2 个子代理`, with the
subagent count only when
there are subagents.
**Groups are Workspaces**, each with the Workspace name, its own counts, and a dot coloured by the m

ost
urgent live phase inside it (grey when nothing is live). Clicking a group head folds it, and the

fold
is remembered by this window rather than by the settings.
**A row is a conversation.** The name is the conversation's title, falling back to its directory and

then a short id. Beside it sits the last tool while it runs (`bash`), `等你` while it waits — a row
t

hat needs the reader says what it needs, not what it called — and `已完成` or `已停止` once it
settles. A

running row can carry its last thought on a second line, and a retained result carries a ✓
that remo
ves that conversation from the pet.
**Subagents are never rows of their own.** They hang indented under the parent that dispatched them,
and they are not counted: a child working is its parent working.

**A click opens that conversation.** Only the window process can raise DSH and only the plugin's
bro

wser half can switch sessions, so the two actions do not wait for each other: the window parks the
r
equest (`PUT /focus`, answered `202`) and the page switches when the request is pushed over SSE. On
Windows the DSH window also comes to the front; elsewhere DSH is opened instead.
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Everything the window can draw comes out of a pure roster fold; the effectful edge publishes it on a
loopback bridge, and the window is an ordinary process that reads it. Either half restarts alone.

The four routes the DSH page uses — `/desktop-pet/focus`, `/desktop-pet/focus/events`,
`/desktop-pet

/client-state`, `/desktop-pet/pet` — are on the **DSH web server**, not the bridge: the
page is serv
ed from that origin, so there is no CORS and no second token.
## Install
Requires **DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2**. The release archive carries a window binary for Windows (x64), macOS
(Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux (x64), so one download installs the whole plugin on any of them

and
nothing is built locally.
### Install the release archive
Point the plugin manager at this asset URL:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

That URL always resolves to the newest release; the asset named after a tag beside it is the same
ar
chive, for pinning one. The archive holds the compiled plugin (`package/lib/`), the browser half, th

e
locale files, `cordis.patch.yml`, and one window binary per platform under
`package/bin/<platform>
-<arch>/` — the plugin starts the one that matches the machine it runs on.
Platform notes:

- **Windows** needs nothing extra.
- **Linux** needs WebKitGTK 4.1 at runtime, which is what a Tauri

window draws with: Debian 12+,
Ubuntu 24.04+ and Fedora 39+ ship it, older releases need it install

ed separately. Without it the
plugin still loads and the window simply never starts.
- **macOS** shi

ps an unsigned binary. If Gatekeeper refuses it, clear the quarantine flag with
`xattr -dr com.apple

.quarantine <path to dsh-desktop-pet>`.
- Clicking a roster row raises the DSH window **only on Wind
ows**; elsewhere it opens DSH instead.
